title: eval-harness: add per-prompt regression CI hooks and metrics integration
author: Ava Thompson
description:
Motivation: prevent regressions in prompt sets and quality metrics from reaching main by integrating per-prompt evaluation checks into CI and surfacing eval metrics as gating signals. This PR adds opt-in CI hooks that run the eval-harness against a small, representative prompt subset on PRs that touch model-facing prompts or eval configs, and wires the resulting metrics into the existing CI pipeline so failing quality thresholds block merges.

What changed (high level): added a lightweight CI job (ci/pipelines/eval-gating.yml) that runs on changed prompt/eval files; implemented a new eval_harness.ci module that loads a configured prompt subset, runs evals in parallel with a strict timeout, computes delta metrics vs. the baseline stored in the repo, and emits a machine-readable report; added an integration that maps eval metrics to CI annotations and a config file (eval_harness/ci_gate_config.yaml) to control thresholds per-metric and per-prompt-group; extended test coverage and docs.

Why: teams have seen occasional prompt regressions that are not caught by unit tests or end-to-end test coverage. The goal is to make small/easy regressions visible earlier without introducing long-running CI jobs. This approach keeps the job lightweight by default and opt-in per-repo or per-route via a config.

Checklist:
- [x] eval_harness.ci implementation and unit tests
- [x] CI pipeline YAML and gating config
- [x] docs for repo-level opt-in and threshold tuning
- [x] integration tests that simulate metric regressions and assert gate behavior
- [x] feature flags for rollout

Notes: The baseline metrics file is stored under eval_harness/baselines/ and is updated via a separate acceptance workflow. This change intentionally does not auto-update baselines during the gating job to avoid masking regressions. Related Linear: ENG-3214, ENG-3250.

review_comments: Diego Martinez: Can we make the default prompt subset size configurable via repo-level config? I worry about noisy failures for large repos.
Ava Thompson: Yes — added eval_harness/ci_gate_config.yaml with prompt_subset_size and per-group thresholds. It defaults to 50 prompts with a 5m timeout.
Priya Patel: LGTM overall. One nit: consider adding a short-circuit path when only docs are changed so we don't run the job unnecessarily.
Ava Thompson: Added pipeline trigger rules to only run when files matching eval_harness/** or prompts/** are touched. Thanks for the catch.
Liam Chen: Approved — tests cover regression and borderline threshold cases.
release_notes: Add opt-in eval-harness CI hooks that run per-prompt subset evals and gate PRs based on configurable quality thresholds. Includes docs and tests.
changes_summary: Implements a lightweight, opt-in CI gating flow for the eval harness: new ci runner, CI pipeline, gating config, baselines docs, and tests. Allows teams to catch prompt-level regressions early and tune thresholds per-group.
notes: Rollout plan: feature-flagged and enabled for a small set of repositories initially. Baseline update is a separate workflow; operators should update baselines after manual verification.
